decisive_items: 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl
response.rationale: Extra-adrenal paraganglioma history, pathogenic SDHB variant, and sustentacular-cell-positive catecholaminergic tumor immunophenotype establish paraganglioma; the prostate lesion is one manifestation, not the overall diagnosis.

rejected.why: Overly site-specific; the disease is multifocal (organ of Zuckerkandl, adrenal bed, prostate) and SDHB-related.
Pheochromocytoma is intra-adrenal; extra-adrenal locations, normetanephrine-predominant biochemistry, and SDHB mutation favor paraganglioma.
Too nonspecific; GATA3, tyrosine hydroxylase, and S100 sustentacular cells specify paraganglioma.
